title: XRP spot, six-venue order-book depth and cross-provider perpetual positioning snapshot

append_only.purpose: Refresh XRP spot, order-book and perpetual positioning evidence while preserving venue coverage, provider disagreements and source-quality limits.

source_capture_policy.reason: Rendered exchange API/page extracts only; the Kraken response exposed no provider event timestamp, and the aggregators did not expose byte-complete exchange payloads or independent timestamp receipts.

limitations: Response body does not expose an exact capture/event timestamp in the rendered extract.
One venue only; ticker data does not establish consolidated executable depth.
The o field is the current UTC-day open, not the rolling 24-hour open.
Full-depth coverage is Coinbase, Bitstamp, Bitfinex and Gemini; OKX and Kraken add near-price depth only.
Resting orders can be cancelled and are not executed flow.
The aggregator includes overlapping exchange venues and is not six independent economic sources.
Seven-contract universe across five venues, not seven exchanges.
No raw exchange payloads, exact contract multipliers or full event-time vintages were preserved.
Overlaps underlying exchange feeds with TradRadar.
Seven-exchange aggregate uses a different venue universe from Kodexius.
Long/short ratio is account-based, not notional exposure.
Liquidations are a lower bound because exchanges disclose only part of real-time liquidations.
Overlaps underlying exchange feeds with Kodexius.

kraken_spot.daily_open_label: current UTC-day open; not a rolling 24-hour open
limitations: Rendered API response did not expose a provider timestamp.
Do not infer a rolling 24-hour open from Kraken's o field.
Resting orders can cancel at any time; this is not executed volume or guaranteed support/resistance.
Coverage narrows from six venues near price to five venues within 10%.
Aggregator venue overlap prevents treating the displayed venue count as six independent source confirmations.

disagreement.explanation: The sources use different universes (seven contracts across five venues versus seven exchanges), and materially different values on shared venues including Bybit and Hyperliquid. Contract IDs, multipliers, quote conversion and raw exchange payloads are not available to reconcile the difference.

supporting_observations: TradRadar reports positive 24-hour price change and open-interest growth.
Fuelmaps shows greater displayed bid than ask depth close to the mid.
TradRadar reports more short than long liquidations over the displayed 24-hour window.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: Spot is below Kraken's 24-hour VWAP and current UTC-day open in the retrieved ticker.
Open-interest aggregates disagree materially and are not reconciled.

supporting_observations: TradRadar reports a 3.23 account long/short ratio and 76.4% long accounts.
Both dashboards display positive weighted funding near +0.01% per eight hours.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: Account ratios are not notional positioning.
TradRadar reports more short than long liquidations in the displayed window.
Funding and open interest are not reconciled across raw contract payloads.

supporting_observations: Perpetual OI differs by approximately $1.176B, or 2.33x, across overlapping but non-identical universes.
Kraken, Fuelmaps and TradRadar show different spot/mark observations at different times and with different definitions.
No raw bytes or independent timestamp anchors were captured for the rendered sources.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: Fuelmaps publishes a clear 14:00 UTC snapshot with stated venue coverage and depth bands.
Kodexius and TradRadar publish explicit update times and methodology notes.

admission.reason: Rendered observations lack byte-complete source receipts, independent timestamp anchoring and synchronized underlying exchange contracts; open-interest disagreement remains unresolved.

next_evidence_requirements: Capture exchange-native XRP spot books and perpetual contracts with byte-exact SHA-256 receipts and event/capture timestamps.
Reconcile Binance, Bybit and Hyperliquid contract IDs, multipliers, quote currencies and venue-level open interest.
Track order-book depth persistence and cancellations rather than treating one snapshot as support.
Obtain synchronized exchange-native funding, OI and liquidation histories before feature admission.
